tokens.name: font-display
tokens.label: Display family
tokens.note: Headings, page titles and the brand name when a component selects the display family.

tokens.name: size-scale
tokens.label: Type scale
tokens.note: Multiplies every text size, including the standard Tailwind sizes.

tokens.name: space-compact-factor
tokens.label: Compact density factor
tokens.note: Scales component padding and the fl-* spacing keys in compact density; raw utilities such as p-3 do not change.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.label: Corner radius
tokens.note: Base for rounded-lg; rounded-xl is 1.5x and rounded-2xl 2x.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.label: Surface
tokens.note: bg-white maps here.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.label: Text on primary
tokens.note: text-white maps here.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.label: Inverse fill
tokens.note: A dark fill that carries on-inverse text: dark buttons, the user's message, solid status fills. Fallback: ink-900.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.label: Text on the inverse fill
tokens.note: Readable on inverse and on a solid status fill. Fallback: surface (text-white on bg-ink-900 is on-primary, which is dark for a light brand).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.label: Brand as text
tokens.note: The brand colour where it is text: at least 4.5:1 on surface and on accent-50. Fallback: accent-600.

tokens.name: accent-ui
tokens.label: Brand as indicator
tokens.note: The brand colour where it is a control or indicator (a selected border, a progress bar): at least 3:1 on surface. Fallback: accent-600.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.label: Minimum height
tokens.note: Unset by default; an explicit height must be at least 32px.

tokens.name: input-height
tokens.label: Minimum height
tokens.note: Unset by default; an explicit height must be at least 32px.

tokens.name: page-header-variant
tokens.label: Style
tokens.note: panel: the page header sits in its own bordered card; core draws it.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.label: Background
tokens.note: Resolved from the sidebar tone unless set.

tokens.name: sidebar-border-width
tokens.label: Border width
tokens.note: A flush sidebar draws a separator of at least the border-width primitive.

tokens.name: nav-item-fg
tokens.label: Text
tokens.note: Resolved from the sidebar tone unless set.

tokens.name: nav-item-hover-bg
tokens.label: Hover background
tokens.note: Resolved from the sidebar tone unless set.

tokens.name: nav-item-hover-fg
tokens.label: Hover text
tokens.note: Resolved from the sidebar tone unless set.

tokens.name: nav-item-variant
tokens.label: Style
tokens.note: tab: a horizontal navigation tab with no fill; the active item has a thick bottom border in the active colour.

tokens.name: navbar-bg
tokens.label: Background
tokens.note: Resolved from the navbar tone unless set.

tokens.name: navbar-fg
tokens.label: Text
tokens.note: Resolved from the navbar tone unless set.

width.note: 56 for rail, 224 for panel. Warns when a rail is wider than 120 or a panel narrower than 160.

max_width.note: 0 means no limit. Applies to page-scroll routes only.
